source: Same quantities on both sides, all at %.17g. Bridge values are what the test observed, read from a temporary print of the report each request returned (run once and reverted, not committed). Kernel values are from Scripts/repro/766-modeling-issue633-blended-edges-duplicate-report/transcript-evidence-fix.txt, made by probe-evidence-fix.mm, which repeats OCCTShapeBlendEdges (BRepFilletAPI_MakeFillet::Add(R, E) per entry in request order, declined edges read back as Contour(E) == 0, then Build). The 10 mm box with edge 0 requested at radius 2 then 5: the declined list, the volume of that request, and the volumes of edge 0 at 5 only and at 2 only. The duplicate equals the last-only volume and differs from the first-only one, so the last radius wins. The test asserts the report's volume equals blendedEdges' and the last-only volume; the first-only volume is measured as well. overwrittenDuplicateIndices, which this test asserts, is Swift bookkeeping over the request list with no kernel counterpart, so it is not in the payload; the payload is what the kernel owns.
